labels.text: 3x M2x10 CSK from below, 4 mm into the deck

1  BAY ENCLOSURE -> motor body
3x M2x10 countersunk (Phillips) UP from under the robot,
through the tongue into the deck

2  SERVO ADAPTER (Waveshare A)  - no screws:
slides down into the rib slots. 5 V in on its screw terminal
(Mini560 OUT+ / OUT-), UART on its 4-pin header (3 jumpers:
TX RX GND - header type open, see REVIEW 2026-11-25)

3  IMU BNO086 - onto the 4 pegs on the rear wall (no screws),
hot glue on the peg tips. Qwiic cable into its RIGHT socket first

4  SWITCH PLATE (bench: M6 nut into its pocket, switch screwed in)
- down 9.5 mm in from the wall, out onto it; 2x M2x10 countersunk
from outside. Then PUSH the 2 jumper housings onto its lugs from
inside (middle + lower lug) - no solder

5  BATTERY 3S 850 mAh (60 x 30 x 20) - hook-and-loop on the floor.
Leads + balance lead out of the rear-right window

7  LID - 4x M2x6 socket into the bay posts
(before the Uno Q: it covers them)

8  UNO Q - 3x M3x8 + 1x M2x6 (hole by the digital header).
Plain jumper housings: 3 on JANALOG 6-7-8 (UART GND, GND, VIN)
under the hood's tunnel; 2 on D0/D1 in the open; Qwiic; USB adapter

9  USB-C -> USB-A right-angle adapter, mouth DOWN;
camera plug zip-tied to the Mini560 box's left wall

10 MINI560 in the HOOD'S BOX (no solder: its 4 pins + jumper housings)
- down into the box from the top, plugs toward the bay, splices
in front of them; back plate slides down behind the lips

10 HOOD with the Mini560 box - 1x M2x6 from each side;
its wires leave over the roof into the tunnel (VIN, GND, UART GND)
